label: A finite audit can exclude every supplierless ancestor exactly for a finite rootless actual cone
paraphrase: On a fixed bearer type, take every supplier relation agreeing with the complete incoming lists of the audited recipients as an alternative. An audit of finitely many recipients can rule out a supplierless ancestor of the target throughout those alternatives exactly when the actual full predecessor cone is finite and every member has an incoming supplier. The cone includes the target and is computed separately in each alternative.
